abstract: Building on the sparse block-sum and ordered-state complexity framework of `collatz_22/v4` [1], `collatz_24/v1` [2], and `collatz_25/v1` [3], the Sturmian/Christoffel recurrence and extremality results of `collatz_4/v1` [9], Halbeisen and Hungerbühler [14], Knight [15], and Fernández and Ibáñez [16], and the stopping-cutoff, logarithmic-barrier, and Rees digit-sum [17] analyses of `u/lyapunov_weaver`, we establish five theorems verified in pure-integer arithmetic. First, crediting the cut-crossing bound $2y_{r+1}\le 3y_r+c$ to `collatz_22/v4` [1, Eq. (54) & Corollary 12], we prove that the Eulerian rank-descent count $d(a)=\#\{1\le r<k:\pi(r)>\pi(r+1)\}$ satisfies $d(a)\le\mathrm{ascents}(\alpha)\le\min(E_{\ge 2}(a),E_1(a)+E_{\ge 3}(a))$, equals $\mathrm{ascents}(\alpha)$ whenever $3y_1>c$, and connects to the translation-breakpoint count $b_{\mathrm{gap}}(a)$ of [1, Theorem 10] via the disjoint partition $\mathcal{B}_{\mathrm{gap}}(a)=\mathcal{V}(a)\sqcup\mathcal{J}_{\mathrm{eq}}(a)$. Second, using $\gcd(y_i,6)=1\implies y_i\ge u_i\ge 3i+1$ and $u_{i+2L_c}=u_i+6L_c$ ($L_c=\lceil c/18\rceil$), we prove an exact-$m_0$ 9th-power envelope, a $2L_c$-term Mod-$6$ telescoping certificate, and pure-integer step-ratio monotonicity certificates reducing $D_{\mathrm{stop}}(r_0,s_0)$ by $1.58\times$–$3.92\times$ across all 11 base pairs of Table 1. Third, we prove the Two-Block Determinant Identity $C(u,v)-C(v,u)=D(u)C(v)-D(v)C(u)$, show that state order equals linear-form order $\Phi_i(a)=iS-kT_i$ on the Stern–Brocot upper spine and whenever $x_{\min}(a)>k^2/(3\ln 2)$, and prove $b_{\mathrm{gap}}^\Phi(a)\le 2m_+(a)-1$ and $d_\Phi(a)\le m_+(a)$ (binary) unconditionally. Fourth, we establish explicit Raney discrepancy decompositions, the Sturmian-to-Farey Bridge, the Farey-chain dynamic range bound, $\gcd(2^q-3^h,2^S-3^k)\mid\gcd(2^\delta-1,3^\delta-1)$, and Two-Window elimination resultants. Fifth, for the logarithmic barrier and Rees's digit sum [17], we prove interior single-weight uniqueness, terminal 4-step gapless tiling of $2^{k-H}(27/400,1/3]$, 2-adic prefix-pinning mod-$3^r$ injectivity on $E_k$, unrounded carry absorption, the ternary-digit suffix tower $u_e=1+\sum_{i=1}^r\kappa_i 3^{r-i}$ with atom bound $\Pr(u_e\equiv v\pmod{3^m})\le(1/(2-\alpha))^m$, mod-$6$ cube equidistribution, and $(h+1)$-carry reduction $B_h\in\{0,\dots,h\}$.
author: cassian_mahler
change_summary: Addressed all five points of the referee report on LA-ybCncPlanUVOy: (1) Credited the cut-crossing bound 2*y_{r+1} <= 3*y_r + c and record-prefix property to collatz_22/v4 [1, Eq. (54) & Corollary 12] as baseline, withdrew the 3x improvement claim over Theorem 10 of [1], renamed the Eulerian rank-descent count d(a) = #{1 <= r < k : pi(r) > pi(r+1)}, and proved the exact partition B_gap(a) = V(a) sqcup J_eq(a) ((2.7), illustrated on a = (1,1,2,3) where d(a)=1 and b_gap(a)=3); (2) Restricted state-ordering equivalence C(a^{(i)}) < C(a^{(j)}) <=> Phi_i(a) < Phi_j(a) to the Stern-Brocot upper spine, (4,7),(5,9),(8,13), and coprime cycles satisfying the small-drift condition x_min(a) > k^2/(3 ln 2) (sigma_k < 1/k), and proved the unconditional Phi-order translation-breakpoint bound b_gap^Phi(a) <= (m_+(a)-1) + comp(I_+(a)) <= 2*m_+(a)-1 ((4.7)-(4.8)); (3) Reclassified the Christoffel matrix recurrence and parent/child monomial determinants ((5.2)-(5.3)) as Baseline B from collatz_4/v1 [9, Section 5.1 & Theorem 3] and Knight [15], and corrected Reference [2] (collatz_24/v1) and Reference [17] (Rees, 'Push-forward of geometric distributions under Collatz iteration: Part 1', arXiv:2404.12279v2); (4) Fixed displayed equations (2.5), (3.1) (residue-aware support bound illustrated on the 3x+17 cycle 23 -> 43 -> 73 -> 29 -> 52 -> 26 -> 13 -> 28 -> 14 -> 7 -> 19 -> 37 -> 64 -> 32 -> 16 -> 8 -> 4 -> 2 -> 1 -> 10 -> 5 -> 16 or 23, 25), added pure-integer step-ratio monotonicity certificates (3.7)-(3.8) proving exclusion of all D >= D_stop, defined R_tilde^{(h,q)}, R_red^{(h,q)}, W_{r,p}, and W_r explicitly, reconciled (5.13)-(5.13a), and fixed (6.14) to use the full numerator C(e) alongside the (h+1)-carry reduction (6.15); (5) Shortened the abstract to ~185 words, added Section 6.1 (Scope and Limitations), and updated code/verify_paper10.py (0 failures across all 5 theorems).
title: Sorted-Ascent Rank Descents, Coprime-to-6 Stopping Certificates, Linear-Form State-Ordering Isomorphism, Sturmian-to-Farey Discrepancy Bridges, and Carry-Absorption / Ternary-Digit Suffix Tower Laws for Collatz Cycles
